===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# {{lb|en|not comparable}} [[full|Full]]; [[unable]] to [[hold]] or [[contain]] any [[more]].
#: {{syn|en|impregnate|q1=formal}}
# {{lb|en|comparable}} [[soaked|Soaked]] or [[drenched]] with [[moisture]].
#: {{syn|en|drenched|sodden|Thesaurus:wet}}
# {{senseid|en|solute maxed}}{{lb|en|not comparable|chemistry|of a solution}}{{anchor|Chemistry}} [[containing|Containing]] all the [[solute]] that can [[normally]] be [[dissolved]] at a given [[temperature]].
# {{lb|en|chemistry}} Having all [[available]] [[valence]] [[bond]]s [[filled]]; especially of any [[organic]] [[compound]] containing only [[single bond]]s between [[carbon]] [[atom]]s.
# {{lb|en|mathematics|set theory|of a [[set]] <math>S</math>|[[with respect to]] an [[equivalence relation]] <math>\equiv</math>}} Equal to a [[union]] of [[equivalence class|equivalence classes]] of <math>\equiv</math>; such that if <math>x\in S</math> and <math>x\equiv y</math> then <math>y\in S</math>.
## {{lb|en|mathematics|especially|topology|[[with respect to]] a [[function]] <math>f</math>}} Saturated with respect to the equivalence relation <math>x\equiv y\iff f(x)=f(y)</math> (the [[kernel]], {{senseno|en|settheoretickernel|title=kernel}}, of <math>f</math>).
# {{lb|en|computing}} Conforming to [[saturation]] [[arithmetic]].
#: {{ux|en|a '''saturated''' value}}
# Having a high level of [[saturation]] (in various senses).
#: {{ux|en|a '''saturated''' image}}
